Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:194803
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 45464 of 2024

Applicant :- Mangal Savita
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Pandey,Rahul Dwivedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ajay Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned
Aga for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
100 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Sumerpur,
District Hamirpur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that technically this is second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant but his first bail application has been dismissed as withdrawn and admittedly the first bail application of the applicant has not been decided on merit.

4. He further submitted that however, applicant is husband of the deceased but on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter alongwith his other family members.

sentences.text: 5. He further submitted that actually mother of the applicant suffered with leprosy and due to the disease of leprosy she developed deformity in her limbs and therefore, she was highly dependable upon the deceased but as diseased did not want to look her after, therefore, she always pressurized the applicant to live separately from his mother but applicant could not leave his mother and only due to this reason deceased committed suicide by hanging herself and after her death FIR of the present case has been lodged on the basis of false allegation.

6. He further submitted that the fact that mother of the applicant was suffering with leprosy and her limbs were deformed, is evident from the report of the senior doctor of District Jail, Hamirpur which has been annexed at page-66 of the paper book.
7. He further submitted that even post mortem report also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

8. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 16.3.2024.
9.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that deceased died due to hanging.

10. He further could not dispute the fact that from the report of the jail doctor which has been annexed as annexure-66 to the affidavit filed in support to the instant bail application it reflects that mother of the applicant suffered with leprosy and her lower limbs have been deformed.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and torture but it reflects that deceased died due to hanging, therefore, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death and considering the report of the jail doctor which has been annexed at page 66 of the paper book, the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant during the course of argument with regard to the alleged suicide committed by the wife of the applicant cannot be ruled out at this stage.
13. Further, applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 16.3.2024 i.e. for last nine months.

14. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant-Mangal Savita, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
